settings.question: How do I place an order?
settings.answer: Add items to your cart, choose your size and color, then check out through the cart drawer. You'll get an email confirmation with your order number right away.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: We move fast to get orders out, but if you reach us within a couple hours of ordering we'll do our best to update or cancel it. Email help@honorinclothing.com with your order number.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and Apple Pay. All payments are securely encrypted.

settings.question: Do you offer gift cards?
settings.answer: Yes — digital gift cards are available in several denominations and are delivered by email with instructions for redemption at checkout.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1–2 business days and typically arrive in 3–5 business days with standard shipping. Expedited options are available at checkout.

settings.question: How much does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Free standard shipping on all orders over $75. Orders under $75 ship at a flat $6 rate within the continental U.S.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: We currently ship within the United States, with Canada coming soon. Sign up for our newsletter to be the first to know when international shipping opens.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships you'll receive a tracking link by email. You can also track it anytime from your account under Order History.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer free 30-day returns on unworn, unwashed items with tags attached — no questions asked. Wear it, test it, love it, or send it back.

settings.question: How do I start a return or exchange?
settings.answer: Head to your account, open the order, and select Start a Return. You'll get a prepaid label and step-by-step instructions. Prefer help? Just contact us.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: Once we receive your return, refunds are processed within 3–5 business days back to your original payment method. Exchanges ship as soon as we receive the original item.

settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Every product page includes a detailed size guide with garment measurements. Measure a piece you already own and compare for the most accurate fit.

settings.question: What if I'm between sizes?
settings.answer: For a relaxed or layering fit, size up. For a trimmer fit, size down. When in doubt, reach out — we're happy to make a recommendation.

settings.question: How should the pieces fit?
settings.answer: Most of our apparel is designed for a modern, true-to-size fit with room to move. Product descriptions note when a style runs relaxed or fitted.

settings.question: How does the veteran giving work?
settings.answer: After our first full year in business, we pledge 10% of annual profits to a carefully selected organization supporting veterans living with PTSD. Every purchase moves that mission forward.

settings.question: What are your products made from?
settings.answer: We use quality, durable materials — recycled ripstop shells, PrimaLoft insulation, heavyweight cottons — chosen to last and made with considered fits and reliable hardware.

settings.question: How should I care for my apparel?
settings.answer: Care instructions are on each product page and garment tag. In general: machine wash cold, tumble dry low, and skip the fabric softener to keep performance finishes working.

settings.question: Do you offer wholesale or partnerships?
settings.answer: Yes — we partner with select retailers and organizations that share our values. Reach out through our Contact page and our team will follow up.
